title: Role-labelled 2D skeleton (skeleton-roles/1). Structure only: the cross-reference rules (one root, chains, one trunk, ...) are checked by scripts/rigging/skeleton_spec.py validate.

view.description: how the character is drawn; never used to count anything

meta.description: free-form provenance (the synthetic generator writes variant, seed and body_seed); never read by the validator

declared_class.description: optional claim of the generator; the class derived from the parts wins

side.description: the body's own side, not the screen side; required for leg, arm, wing; L, R or C for fin

girdle.description: leg, arm, wing: attached at the hips (pelvic) or the shoulders (pectoral); null for 6 or more legs

layer.description: drawing order against the trunk (far-side limbs are behind)

visible.description: false = the part exists on the body but has no artwork in this drawing (far legs of a profile); it still counts

secondary.description: follow-through motion (tail, ears, hair, cloth); defaults: tail and extra true, others false

parent.description: null for the single root, which belongs to the trunk

pos.description: [x, y] in the rest pose, y up, any scale

part.description: the id of the part this joint belongs to (every joint belongs to exactly one)

role.description: optional name inside the part: hip, knee, ankle, toe; shoulder, elbow, wrist; ...

limits.description: optional rotation limits in degrees [min, max]
